name: role_audit_trigger_v13
comment: The trigger snapshot (ADR-0042): a trigger records its neutral declaration — relation, timing, events in the fixed order, updateOf when declared, the body whitespace-collapsed with its tokens unexpanded — so one snapshot serves every dialect. Every implementation must export this exact document from the trigger its native Role entity links.

expect.sql: insert into role_changes (role_id, role_name, changed_at) select n.id, n.role_name, {now} from {new: id, role_name} n;
